text.tspan: M6 ship run: f8 run --flow ship 12 → a ready PR (the human merges)
Proposed in openspec/changes/m6-ship-workflow. Temporal holds the flow and its state; git holds only the work (design.md, tests, code, PR comments).
Blue: an agent step in its own sandbox factory8-<runId>-<stage>, running /factory8:<skill> and ending with a JSON result line · grey: workflow code or an activity
purple: the engineer · dashed orange: a route back · orange: an end, which also runs finish (the PR stays a draft) · red: the run fails with no finish
starts shipWorkflow {runId, repo, issue}; every 10 s it reads the state query
(stage, attempt, risk, PR, open question, each step's model and result)
and prints new stages, and questions with the f8 answer line
reads FACTORY8_BANDS and FACTORY8_PLUGIN once per run;
every step loads the plugin as of the run's start time
or implement is empty; fails before any sandbox

g.text: Contract: graded before any code (2 grades at most)
Implement loop (every new loop starts again at ladder profile 1)

text.tspan: wait for the answer signal, with no pod
the diagnoser posted the question on the PR;
finish (runs on every orange end too)
posts report(state) on the PR, or on the issue if no PR exists:
the outcome, each step's model and result, the causes,
and non-blocking findings as follow-ups; gh pr ready only when ready
the run succeeds and returns the PR's URL;
the PR is ready and unmerged: the human merges or not
escalated | too_big | parked: the run fails, non-retryable;
type = the outcome, message = cause + note; the PR stays a draft

g.text: Inside every blue box: one step(); finally, deleteSandbox (the pod goes, the PVC stays)

text.tspan: opens the draft PR, sets risk low | high
may raise the risk to high
failing tests for each acceptance row,
each test must be able to fail
a rework gets the blocking findings
code-review-n (risk high: n-a ∥ n-b, two sandboxes)
1. runs the repo's checks: a failure is a blocker
2. git diff tests_sha sha -- tests: any diff is critical
3. ranked findings: only blocker and critical send work back
exactly one cause A–I, with evidence,
one more reviewer on the last commit
checks the plugin out as of at, into /f8/plugin;
delete the pod, keep the PVC;
state.question is set; wait for the answer signal
createSandbox again: same name, same PVC;
failed: the run fails at once,
the summary's last line as JSON,
D: the fix list is exact →
one more attempt, once per loop
stopped A (tests wrong) or B (false premise);
an unknown cause counts as B
then the tests review and a new loop
B, G, E: design-n+1 with the note,
then both reviews, acceptance and a new loop
